headline: Production database is being made publicly accessible to the internet
suppressed: The database is not encrypted at rest (storage_encrypted: false), but this is a pre-existing condition unrelated to this change.

findings.evidence_ref: data_stores.tf: publicly_accessible changed from false to true on aws_db_instance.main
findings.explanation: The production RDS instance (acme-prod-db) will become reachable from the public internet. Even with the security group restricting connections, this significantly expands the attack surface on a database holding application data.
